<div class="card-body">
'''Juri Juice''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Utinni Effect]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ジュリ・ジュース</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「カンティーナ（酒場）」「モス・アイズリー」「ジャバのセイル・バージ」のいずれかが場に出ている時に使う。好きなエイリアンに配備する。そのエイリアンは、戦闘の際に特殊能力を使えない（カーベに配備したなら、“盗む”こともできなくなる）。このカードをキャンセルするためには、そのエイリアンを上記以外の位置に、自分でビークルを“運転”せずに移動させる必要がある。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">酒場の定番の飲料。多くの種族に酔わせる効果がある。モス・アイズリーの盗賊カーベやチャドラ＝ファンの好物。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Juri Juice.

'''Card text:''' Use when Cantina, Mos Eisley or Jabba's Sail Barge is on the table. Deploy on any alien. That alien cannot use special ability in battle; if deployed on Kabe, she also cannot steal. To cancel this card, the alien must move to a location other than those listed above without personally driving a vehicle.

'''Lore:''' A standard cantina beverage that intoxicates many species. A favorite of Kabe, a Mos Eisley thief, and Chadra-Fan.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to cancel the card by moving the alien to a location other than those listed above; the English says to move that alien to one of those sites. The Japanese lore names Kabe and Chadra-Fan as fans of the drink; the English describes Kabe as a Chadra-Fan thief.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Juri Juice]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=239s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:59.</ref>
